title: JA Nova wp7: toggle, touch submenus, registration, logos, career icons, drawer, wording, login, search behave like the source
steps: S1: A WordPress site running the wp-ja-nova theme under test (local stand from the quickstart pack, or https://ja-nova-wordpress.tracy.site once released) and the Joomla source (local stand from quickstart/ja-nova/j6, or https://ja-nova-joomla.tracy.site).

S2: From the TCH checkout run: node tasks/ja-nova-wp7/tools/measure115.mjs --site <site> --source <source> --out <dir> --mode after --wp '<wp-cli prefix for the site>' (add --zip <theme.zip> --record <BROWSER.json> to bind the run to the theme bytes).
S3: Read the TOTAL line and each PASS/FAIL line.
expect: theme: the first click on the theme toggle changes the page background on a light OS and on a dark OS (1440 and 390).
touch-nav: at 1024 and 1180 with touch, the first tap on a parent menu item opens its submenu and keeps the URL; the second tap navigates.
registration: the registration form creates a subscriber account.
logos, header-order, career-icons, drawer, wording, login-required, passkey, advanced-search: each PASS with an empty bad list.
evidence: Independent audit 03/10/2026; measure115 0/11 on 1.1.3, 11/11 on 1.1.5 bound to wp-ja-nova-1.1.5.zip a1a1201f (tasks/ja-nova-wp7/release/BROWSER.json)
fence: Browser-measured behaviour of the shipped theme against the source; the tool fails closed on a crash
